items.title: Nick Mondello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 19, 2022
items.q: Charles was basically the production consultant... They went to North Texas State Press

ctx.x: It’s a great, great, great book. And the thing that they did was they, and Charles was basically the production consultant, and he’s a former drummer too. They went to North Texas State Press, all right? The book, and my daughter is a librarian so she knows about books. And I showed this book to her and I says, “This is really well manufactured.” Of course the book was written incredibly well. It’s a great, great, great book. Okay? But they were wise enough to take control over the production, okay, of the book.…
Were you — this is a bit of a tangent but — when you were growing up were you an avid reader of LP liner notes?
